_help: Cards the bot watches on eBay (eBay Australia, Buy It Now, posts to Australia). 'max' is the most you'd pay in AUD delivered: item + postage + the 10% GST eBay adds on items from overseas. 'search' is typed into eBay; every 'must_have' entry has to be in the listing title ('a|b' means either); any 'exclude' word skips the listing. Set 'enabled' to false to stop watching a card. Needs a free eBay key: see the top of ebay_watch.py.
